purpose: Present a conclusion that follows naturally from known facts.
keywords: Plain form + わけだ; noun / な-adjective + な + わけだ
The heating had stopped. That explains why it was cold.
At ten pages a day, that works out to three hundred pages in a month.
He grew up in this town. No wonder he knows the streets well.
formation: Plain form + わけだ; noun / な-adjective + な + わけだ
restrictions: Often signals that a new fact makes the situation understandable.
mistake: Use わけだ for “that explains it,” not a prediction without a basis.
